newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil soft, buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil soft, buyers scarce.

text.p: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady to weaker on Monday, traders said.

An ARA refiner bought a good quality M-100 cargo from Tallinn at around a dollar over the mean of means, cif ARA. This was close to barge levels and dealers said refiners' indifference to straight-run barrels as feedstock material was pressuring prices.
Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was steady to weaker and the market remained long, with few buyers in evidence. Prices were pegged at around $110-$112 fob NWE.
